question_text: A toy car shown in figure (a) having an isolated metal axle $PQ$ travels with a constant speed $v$ along a sinusoidal path whose vertical cross-section is in the $x$-$y$ plane. The axle $PQ$ is of length $l$. If the axle $PQ$ coincides with the $y$ axis at $t = 0$, a uniform magnetic field of flux density $B$ exists throughout the region in the $z$ direction. Which of the following shows the variation of the induced emf ($e$) at the end $P$ of the axle with respect to end $Q$ with time ($t$) is best represented by. (Neglect the effect of the Earth magnetic field).
